# Meta prompt

> I am a student who is analyzing data related to development and health. Find ViveCodingExample.qmd in XXX folder and render. I will update the file each time I receive your outputs written in the file. 

# Procedure

* I will add instructions as you provide outputs. 
* You will add outputs under each instruction. Add "X+1th query" subsection when you respond to the X-th query.
* Outputs must be R or Python codes. R is the most preferred language. Use Python only if you cannot achieve using R.
* Code blocks must not result in a horizontal scroll bar. Use linebreaks.
* Use a Tufte style css.
* Outputs must be succinct. Do not provide any anaylitical comments. Provide only data related information that is useful in interpreting outputs. 

# Instructions and outputs

## 1st query

### Instructions

* I am trying to find empirical relationship between child mortality and per capita health spending across countries. 
* Final output is a group of graphs showing time series changes by country in a single figure.
* X axis is spendings, Y axis is mortality, and points are connected by a line for a same country.
* Find most suitable variables from WB data, WHO, DHS.
